source:
@@U01197@@
Who knows, he may be dead!
Oh, dear!
If only I had a death certificate.

@@U01199@@
(Entering.)

@@U01200@@
玛尔特!

@@U01202@@
What is it, 格蕾琴 dear?

@@U01204@@
My knees are shaking so, I can’t stand!
I found another, in the clothespress,
another casket, this one of ebony,
and filled with such beautiful things,
far grander than the first.

@@U01206@@
Not a word to your mother, hear?
She'd only give it to the priest again.

@@U01208@@
Look at them!
Oh, just look!

@@U01210@@
(Putting them on her.)

@@U01211@@
Oh, you lucky, lucky thing, you!

@@U01213@@
I wouldn't dare wear them on the street.
Nor in church, either.
Oh, what a pity!

@@U01215@@
You can come here often as you please,
bring them with you and wear them in secret.
You'll stroll up and down in front of the mirror
for an hour or so,
and wont we be happy!
And finally there'll come a holiday
translation:
@@U01197@@
谁知道，他可能已经死了！
哦亲爱的！
要是我有死亡证明就好了。

@@U01199@@
（进入。）

@@U01200@@
玛尔特！

@@U01202@@
亲爱的格蕾琴，这是什么？

@@U01204@@
我的膝盖在颤抖，我无法站立！
我在熨衣机里发现了另一个，
另一个棺材，这个是乌木的，
并充满如此美丽的事物，
比第一个宏伟得多。

@@U01206@@
没有对你妈妈说一句话，听到了吗？
她只会再次把它交给牧师。

@@U01208@@
看看他们！
哦，看看吧！

@@U01210@@
（把它们戴在她身上。）

@@U01211@@
哦，你真幸运，你真幸运！

@@U01213@@
我不敢穿它们上街。
教堂里也不行。
噢，真遗憾！

@@U01215@@
你可以经常来这里，只要你愿意，
带上它们并秘密佩戴它们。
你会在镜子前走来走去
一个小时左右，
我们会高兴吗！
假期终于来临
